test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight people are sitting around a circular table at equal distances, facing the centre. Lalit is an immediate neighbour of both Chirag and Pihu. Kiran is to the immediate right of Sanjay. Only three people sit between Sia and Pihu. Asha is third to the right of Chirag. Only three people sit between Kiran and Rajiv. Sia is an immediate neighbour of Rajiv and Asha. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Asha?
solution:
Given, 

1. Asha is third to the right of Chirag. Lalit is an immediate neighbour of both Chirag and Pihu.

case 1: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8eae1a99a4c543d929709295ba4882f86b61c5d3aa8e34dd912c9e0bce51425.png] 

case2: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/789be3f074cd837ce68c7c43212eaedf6ff567fdf2f2cd5b4720909dc4b27c96.png] 

2. Kiran is to the immediate right of Sanjay. so** case 1 gets cancelled.** Only three people sit between Kiran and Rajiv.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d5521f63f3005e56d595fe96bdedf2f771df096a1c95a8311dcdd5f9a945ae0.png] 

3. Sia is an immediate neighbour of Rajiv and Asha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41e4736ca23edde9a812ab17af5b181a3949347d7edda448625d52797692bc46.png] 

so **Sanjay** is sitting to the immediate right of Asha.
